name: QR Create prod - Record based checks
description: Record-based checks: 1a (2+ refund requests from the same customer, any request type), 1b (refund across 2+ transactions or subscriptions, refunds only), 2 (refund request after an earlier ticket has Rejection Complaint = yes). Returns a verdict.

parameters.url: ={{ "https://" + $("Get Project Config").first().json.zendesk_domain + ".zendesk.com/api/v2/search.json?query=" + encodeURIComponent("type:ticket requester:" + $("When Executed by Another Workflow").first().json.requester_email) + "&sort_by=created_at&sort_order=desc&per_page=100" }}

parameters.content:
# QR Create prod - Record based checks

Brand copy of `CS - Record based checks [Template]` (template sync, 19 Oct 2026).

Called from `QR Create prod - Main automation flow` (nodes `RB: Record based checks` and `RB2: Record based checks`) with project_key, ticket_id, requester_email, transactions_json, refunded_transactions_json, chargeback_transactions_json and request_type (r / c).

Get Project Config reads `record_checks_enabled`, `record_checks_enforce` (cases 1a, 1b, 2), `record_case6_enabled`, `record_case6_enforce` (case 6), `record_refund_tag_prefix`, `ticket_field_rejection_complaint` and `zendesk_domain` from `cs_project_config` (row qrcreate_prod). With the switches off no case is evaluated.

Returns one item with the verdict (`rb_matched`, `rb_should_block`, `rb_cases`, `rb_tags`, `rb_reason`, ...).

## Brand-specific
Zendesk credential on `RB: Requester ticket history` is QR Create.
